name: Oouuh AI
blurb: Two photos in: one of you strums the ukulele, the other sings the Oouuh.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Two reference photos, one person each. Keep each exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone and build, and never swap them. Keep their own clothes. They stand side by side in a narrow home kitchen hallway (white cabinets, warm wood floor, a wooden door at the back, warm ceiling light), filmed full body by a phone fixed at chest height. The person from the FIRST photo stands on the left and strums a small natural-wood ukulele in a steady, bouncy rhythm, nodding along. The person from the SECOND photo stands on the right and sings a long, smooth "ooouuh" straight at the camera with one hand on their chest, then bobs their head, points at the lens and leans in with a cheeky grin. Both sway to the beat; on the last strum they look at each other and laugh. One continuous take, vertical 9:16. Audio: a light acoustic ukulele groove with a soft wordless "ooouuh" vocal hum, no other lyrics. No other people, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text: Two reference photos, one person each. Keep each exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone and build, and never swap them. Dress the person from the FIRST photo all in black, a big black hooded jacket with the hood up, and the person from the SECOND photo in a sleeveless electric-blue sequin top, sheer black gloves and black trousers. They stand side by side in a narrow home kitchen hallway (white cabinets, warm wood floor, a wooden door at the back, warm ceiling light), filmed full body by a phone fixed at chest height. FIRST, on the left, strums a small natural-wood ukulele completely deadpan, barely moving. SECOND, on the right, sings a long, dramatic "ooouuh" at the camera, eyes wide, one gloved hand pressed to the chest, swaying slowly like a diva. One continuous take, vertical 9:16. Audio: a light acoustic ukulele groove with a soft wordless "ooouuh" vocal hum, no other lyrics. No other people, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
